title: Spot gold after a 10-year bond shock it shrugged off

rule.shock: 10-year bond CFD daily return / sd of the 250 previous common-day returns, |z| >= 1, and gold's same-day |z| < 0.5
rule.baseline: same side and hold entered at every gold candle of the same year (mean)
rule.costs: $0.60 a round trip + nights() x FIN.xau.long on buys

tests.what: bond price z <= -1 (yields up hard) and gold |z| < 0.5 the same day: buy gold at the next open, 5 candles (primary)

control.what: bond z shuffled among the days of each calendar year; gold days and the gold |z| < 0.5 filter kept

tests.what: bond price z >= +1 (yields down hard) and gold |z| < 0.5: sell gold at the next open, 5 candles

control.what: bond z shuffled among the days of each calendar year; gold days and the gold |z| < 0.5 filter kept

tests.what: T1 event: buy gold at the next open, 1 candle

control.what: bond z shuffled among the days of each calendar year; gold days and the gold |z| < 0.5 filter kept
